contents.reason: The classification of split reductive groups of semisimple rank one (Milne 20.33) is not needed for the four promised claims of this pair: root subgroups, Bruhat and parabolics use only the central isogeny SL_2 to the derived group (20.32). Its proof additionally needs the deconstruction of reductive groups from triples (Milne 19.23-19.29), a classification subject that belongs with the future integral/classification page proposed as design candidate AG-RED-SG-1; the owner should confirm that placement.
